title: Finding
description: One review finding. `id` is assigned by scripts/validate-result.mjs, not by the model.

ruleId.description: Rule from rules/*.md, or GEN for a finding no rule covers.

confidence.description: confirmed = the failing path was traced end to end (or a test proves it).

repo.description: Repo key; defaults to the reviewed repo. Set it for findings in a consumer repo.

file.description: Path relative to the repo root, forward slashes.

line.description: Line in the NEW version of the file.

anchor.description: Stable symbol the finding is about (Class#method, table name, topic, component). Used for the finding id, so it must not change between runs.

verification.description: What the verify pass did to confirm it.

consensus.description: Runs that reported it, e.g. 2/2 (consensus mode).

ratedSeverity.description: The model's rating before a severity floor raised it (finalize).

crossVerification.description: What the cross-model verifier (the other provider) concluded.
